summary: Verifier upholds 7.0/10. Nurrow is NOT ON PAR (below 7.5) and has no blocker. Build check: the md5 of nurrow.glb at HEAD, 874f3f6d1 and 89112e613 is efdfbabf, and only ac10d5386 (the reverted GF-1 regrade) differs. The Nov 6 three_* sheets therefore show the shipped mesh, and no recapture was needed. Load was 3.07-3.51, so timing is not_measured. My own GLB parse (KHR_mesh_quantization int16 quaternions dequantized) gives 17 clips and 21,151 triangles, a 6.00 s recall, a 1.67 s death and a 2.00 s taunt. cast_ult has the worst local cape step at 53.3 deg/frame on x_cape_1. M1 and M2 are confirmed on the cards. M3 is confirmed as a major, with corrected evidence. The '14 of 16 frames disc' count comes from the three_ sheet's near-vertical camera, which exaggerates the issue: at the real 52 deg game camera the pale disc covers the top 0.53 of the height (closing_nurrow_hat_share.txt), and the lunge reads in closing_nurrow_ingame_casts_x2.png. The ult cape pop is real, and it is the clip's worst step. The reviewer's 'every other clip <= 14.8 deg' holds only for the swing-chain metric: local steps on cast_a2, cast_a3 and crit reach 34-36 deg. Minors are kept. Sensitivity is clean: a wide, flat brim with a small hooked finial, and a smiling carved mask in game and on the base and Shadeprint cards. The Noon Fair hand-over-face reads as smeared, not as horror.

gapStatus.evidence: fw_CW5_r3v1_lineup.json: the feet bands are fixed (f90 33.7, f180 33.4). The tops are still low: f90 61.8, f180 60.5, against f0 71.8.
The GLB md5 efdfbabf is unchanged. closing_nurrow_ingame_measure.txt: hat L* p50 83.9, p95 87.8, matte. three_nurrow.png hat close-up: gore lines only.

findings.title: Splash and portrait cards are posterized model renders composited onto plates, all in one framing
findings.what: All six cards are median-filtered game renders placed in the right third of the frame (mass x 0.70-0.72, feet 0.92-0.93). The figure's light does not match the plate: a flat pale-cream figure stands against an orange-lit dusk city, and the face is faceted blocks.
findings.evidence:
- Viewed art/out/fighters/nurrow/splash.png and portrait.png.
- _harness/_reports/closing_nurrow_cardqa.txt: figure grain p50 4.8-8.0 against plate grain 0.4-1.0, 6 cards.
findings.gauge: A LoL skin ships a painted splash with unified light and its own composition. The portrait is a crop of that painting.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced on the current files: card mtimes are Nov 4 and the GLB is unchanged. The gauge claim is fair. This is a major, not a blocker: the cards are legible and on-model.

findings.title: Noon Fair portrait: the face is an unreadable smeared mass under a clawing hand
findings.what: The hand covers the mask, and after posterizing the face is tan streaks. The fingers read as claws.
findings.evidence:
- Viewed art/out/fighters/nurrow/nurrow_noon_fair_portrait.png: the face region is at about 190-330 x 140-300.
- _harness/_shots/closing_nurrow_face_nurrow_noon_fair_portrait_x3.png.
findings.gauge: A LoL skin portrait keeps a clean face as its focal point.
findings.fix: Re-pose the hand clear of the face (brim tip or hush finger). Exclude the face from the filter and hand-paint the lids and smile.
findings.verifierNote: Viewed it myself. The face really is lost. It reads as smeared rather than as horror, so it is not sensitivity-class. It is the store card's focal point, so major stands.

findings.title: Ult cape snaps in one frame and the blade trails; hat disc dominates the cast read
findings.what: In cast_ult the cape flips up as one sheet between two frames. In lunges the blade trails low instead of leading, and the pale brim covers the head and upper torso.
findings.evidence:
- My parse, _harness/_reports/closing_nurrow_verify_chainlocal.txt: cast_ult local step on x_cape_1 is 53.3 deg/frame (39 keys over 1.33 s). That is the worst of 17 clips; next are crit 36.1, cast_a2 35.1 and cast_a3 34.7.
- _harness/_reports/closing_nurrow_chain.txt: chain-swing step 70.1 / 102.2 deg.
- three_nurrow.png row 2, frames 5-6: the cape sheet pops above the hat.
- At the 52 deg game camera the disc covers the top 0.53 of the height (closing_nurrow_hat_share.txt). The legs and crouch still read: _harness/_shots/closing_nurrow_ingame_casts_x2.png, closing_nurrow_t70_game_fig_x4.png.
findings.gauge: A LoL assassin's dash and ult keep a readable action line at the game camera. The weapon leads, and cloth never pops in a single frame.
findings.fix:
- Re-bake the ult cape with substeps, or clamp it at 25-30 deg/frame.
- Lead with the blade level at impact.
- Counter-pitch the hat back 15-20 deg on lunge and impact frames.
findings.verifierNote: The severity holds on the ult cape pop and the trailing blade. The reviewer overstated the disc. '14 of 16 frames' comes from the near-vertical three_ sheet camera; at the real 52 deg camera the body and legs read under the brim. 'Every other clip <= 14.8 deg' is true only for the chain-swing metric; local steps reach 34-36 deg in other casts, though cast_ult is still the outlier.

findings.title: The lacquer hat and carved mask have no sheen; the hat sits in the tone map's shoulder
findings.what: The hat is matte cream with no specular band. Hat L* p50 is 83.9 and p95 is 87.8.
findings.gauge: LoL lacquer reads glossy through a painted highlight band.
findings.fix: Paint a highlight band, darken the seams, and drop the lit end 2-3 L*.
findings.verifierNote: The measurement and the image agree.

findings.title: Face chip is confusable with Tunlan's at use size
findings.what: Both chips show a pale hat over a pale mask at 32-48 px.
findings.gauge: LoL icons differ by silhouette and key colour at use size.
findings.fix: Crop tighter on the brim ellipse and the blue-gem rim, on a plum ground.
findings.verifierNote: Kept: the icon is unchanged since Oct 28.

findings.title: Noon Fair is one lilac body with a pink pauldron; the base card's cloak drifts rosy
findings.what: Noon Fair has no palette hierarchy. The base splash cloak reads salmon.
findings.gauge: A LoL skin holds its palette hierarchy from store to match.
findings.fix: Darken the undersuit, return the pauldron to walnut, and keep the pink on the brim lining only.

findings.title: Side and back top value bands stay under 70
findings.what: Seen from the side or back, the top band is about 61, against 71.8 from the front.
findings.gauge: A LoL champion keeps its value hierarchy from every facing.
findings.fix: Lift the side and back planes 4-6 L*.
